title: Share of US adults with no religious affiliation, over time

source.name: Religious 'nones' trend (General Social Survey / Religious Landscape Study)

notes: The share of US adults identifying as atheist, agnostic, or 'nothing in particular' rose from roughly 8% in 1990 to about 29% by 2021, per Pew Research Center's long-running tracking of religious disaffiliation. Figures approximate, rounded.
